text:
Detective Vance leaned in, his voice dropping to a gravelly whisper that cut through the sterile hum of the interrogation room. "Don't look at the floor, Miller. Look at me. Where were you the night of the 14th?"

Miller’s eyes darted to the two-way mirror, then snapped back to the detective. He swallowed hard, his Adam's apple bobbing visibly. "I told you. I was home. All night. I swear on my mother’s life, I didn’t move from that couch."

Vance didn’t blink. He just watched the sweat bead on Miller’s forehead, waiting for the crack in the armor.
